## Checks

- [ ] Tests added or updated; `python -m pytest` passes
- [ ] If the showcase changed: `node showcase/sandbox/check_core.js` and `python -m unittest discover -s showcase -p "test_*.py"` pass, and new page text exists in both languages
- [ ] No archived report under `reports/` with recorded hashes was edited
- [ ] New empirical numbers cite a source; no vendor data committed
- [ ] Results from new runs are labelled as development unless they follow a pre-registered design
